# JF Aluminum Doors

> Family-owned aluminum door and window manufacturer and installer based in South Los Angeles, serving Los Angeles County, Orange County, and the Inland Empire since 2011. We fabricate and install custom aluminum doors, sliding patio doors, windows, storefronts, and gates for both residential and commercial clients.

## Business details

- **Name:** JF Aluminum Doors
- **Founded:** 2011 (family-owned and operated)
- **Address:** 5832 Holmes Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90001
- **Phone:** (323) 277-9270
- **License:** California Contractor License #1130494
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 3:30 PM (closed weekends)
- **Languages:** English and Spanish
- **Service area:** Los Angeles County, Orange County, and the Inland Empire (all of Southern California)

## Services

- Custom aluminum entry doors — single doors and pairs
- Sliding and bi-fold aluminum patio doors
- Aluminum windows and picture windows
- Commercial storefronts and curtain wall systems
- Aluminum gates and enclosures
- Glass, door closers, and hardware supply and installation

## Finishes

- Clear anodized aluminum
- Bronze anodized aluminum
- Custom powder-coat colors

## How to get a quote

Call (323) 277-9270 for a free quote. JF Aluminum Doors handles fabrication in-house at its South Los Angeles shop and installs throughout Southern California.
